VANCOUVER, British Columbia, November 24, 2026 – TheNewswire - Yocale.ai Inc.

(OTCQB: YOAIF) (Frankfurt: K4G) (“Yocale.ai” or the “Company”), the AI-powered operating system for the beauty and wellness industry, today launched a promotions engine that lets businesses create and share discount codes with clients, bringing percentage and fixed-amount discounts, first-visit offers, service-specific promotions, custom offer codes, usage limits and expiry dates directly into Yocale’s booking, point-of-sale and invoicing workflows. Each redemption is recorded against the client’s appointments, purchases and history.

Offers are a routine part of how beauty and wellness businesses attract new clients and bring existing clients back, from first-visit discounts at a medspa to seasonal promotions at a salon. A medspa might use an introductory offer to bring in a first-time client, encourage a second treatment, and eventually enroll that client in a multi-session package or monthly membership.

Many standalone promotion tools sit apart from a business’s appointments, client records and payments. Yocale.ai’s promotions work inside the same system used to run appointments, so the offer, the payment and the client history stay together.

“For a beauty or wellness business, offering a discount is easy. Knowing whether it helped grow the business is much harder,” said Aydin Asli, Chief Executive Officer of Yocale.ai. “We want owners to connect the dots. They can run different promotions side by side, see which ones brought customers back and which built lasting relationships, then put their effort into what works and attracts the right customers.  That’s the difference between simply offering discounts and building a more intelligent business.”
New Promotion Capabilities
Flexible Offers –  Percentage or fixed-amount discounts, first-visit offers and service-specific promotions.
Targeted Promotions – Offers limited to specific services, products, packages, gift cards, staff members, locations, days or times.
Purchase Rules – Minimum purchase amounts, minimum item counts and maximum discount caps.
Custom Discount Codes – Codes created for specific marketing campaigns.
Usage Limits and Expiry Dates – Control over how often a code can be redeemed, and limited-time promotions with a set end date.
Redemption Across Booking and Payment –  Discount codes accepted at online booking, in-person checkout and on invoices, using the same invoicing and payment workflows as other eligible transactions.
Client-Connected Redemptions – Each redemption saved with the client’s appointments, purchases and history, so businesses can see what happened after the offer.

Two promotions can generate 100 redemptions each while producing very different results. One may attract clients who visit once, while the other attracts clients who return regularly, purchase additional treatments or enroll in memberships. That difference is difficult to see when marketing, bookings, and payments are managed in separate systems.

Because the promotions engine records each redemption against the client’s appointments, purchases and history, businesses can follow what happens after an offer is used. Yocale.ai is building on this data foundation to support deeper analysis of promotional effectiveness, customer value, and repeat-visit patterns as its AI and data-intelligence capabilities evolve.

The introduction of the promotions engine advances the commercialization roadmap Yocale.ai previously disclosed, which prioritizes industry-specific functionality, integrated commerce, embedded fintech and AI-powered capabilities. With invoicing, payments, memberships, packages, gift cards and now promotions connected in one platform, Yocale.ai continues to build an operating environment that helps businesses attract clients, transact and build long-term relationships. As adoption grows, promotion redemptions by Yocale.ai customers  paid through Yocale Pay generate payment-processing revenue for the Company under its commercial arrangements, while adding client data available for reporting and automation.
About Yocale.ai

Yocale.ai Inc. (CSE: YAI) is an AI-powered operating system for the beauty and wellness industry, serving businesses from independent salons and medspas to multi-location enterprise wellness brands. Combining vertical SaaS, embedded fintech, data intelligence, and AI automation within a single configurable platform, Yocale.ai unifies customer acquisition, bookings, payments, client engagement, and day-to-day operations, creating a connected operational data foundation for AI-driven automation and decision support across the business. Built on more than a decade of technology development through the Yocale platform, the Company's technology has supported thousands of service providers across more than 22 countries. Yocale.ai is headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia.
